description.value:
You exploit a vulnerability placed into a tech system, then command the creature to do one of following of your choice: Stride in a direction of your choice, attempt a Strike against a creature of your choice with a –4 status penalty, or drop a weapon it's wielding. The target must attempt a Fortitude save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target can't Delay or take any reactions for the duration of the spell. Reduce the target's glitching value by 1.

Failure As success, but the target must spend the first action on its turn to obey your command.

Critical Failure As failure, but the value of the target's glitching value isn't reduced.

Heightened (+2) You can target one additional creature.

duration.value: until the end of the target’s next turn
